parsed.query_formatada:
SELECT
  p.num_mes_referencia AS mes,
  SUM(CAST(p.vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS valor_diarias
FROM despesa_pagamento p
JOIN empenho_empenho e
  ON p.seq_empenho = e.seq_empenho
  AND p.ano_referencia = e.ano_referencia
WHERE p.ano_referencia = 2025
  AND COALESCE(p.nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%'
  AND COALESCE(p.num_doc_credor, '') NOT IN ('-1', '0')
  AND CAST(e.cod_orgao AS INTEGER) IN (2, 4, 5)
  AND (
    e.dsc_naturezadespesa ILIKE '3.3.90.14%'
    OR e.dsc_naturezadespesa ILIKE '%DIARI%'
  )
  AND e.dsc_funcao ILIKE '%ASSIST%'
GROUP BY p.num_mes_referencia
ORDER BY p.num_mes_referencia;
